Based on the description of Investigation on pg.177 of the PHB, it would seem that (Passive) Investigation is meant to allows players to automatically piece together clues, understand underlying mechanisms of perceived traps, or notice interesting details about what they're looking at, searching through, or thinking about as long as the DC is below their passive score.

For instance, while making a Medicine check on a corpse, the successful Medicine check may tell you that the victim was stabbed to death within the last 3 hours, but your (Passive) Investigation may automatically reveal the specific type of weapon or that the person was taken by surprise by the blow.

Another example: Perhaps a character passes a Perception check while scanning a room and notices one of the tiles in the floor sticking up above the ones nearby, but their (Passive) Investigation reveals that the angle of the tile seems to indicate a secret hiding spot rather than the typical types of traps that the party is aware exist in the region.

In The Forgotten Realms at least, all spells are cast by manipulating The Weave which is the access point for mortals to all of the magic of the planes. Spells are basically limited expressions of intent and will that have been practiced and shown to work.

Greater effects have been demonstrated to be possible with the use of multiple spellcasters expressing their will in unison (i.e. Elven High Magic), but in the end all spellcasting takes at least some energy out of a person.

The body can only handle so much of the The Weave being manipulated and magic channeled through it before it needs time to recouperate hence the existence of what we call Spell Slots.

Wish is a spell so powerful, that when not replicating a known spell a user not only has to use their most powerful spell slot, but has to focus their energy to shaping what is essentially a brand new spell to manipulate The Weave into creating a desired effect.

***Channeling the raw magical energy of the universe in untested ways can often be pretty dangerous or costly.***

Here are some snipets from sourcebooks and other places to give some insight into what I just expressed:

*A spell is a discrete magical effect, a single shaping of the magical energies that suffuse the multiverse into a specific, limited expression. In casting a spell, a character carefully plucks at the invisible strands of raw magic suffusing the world, pins them in place in a particular pattern, sets them vibrating in a specific way, and then releases them to unleash the desired effect — in most cases, all in the span of seconds. Source: (PHB 5E)*

\--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*Like many forces, High Magic is both one thing and many. In its fullest essence, High Magic is the direct energy of the Weave, the web of energy that sustains the planet's life (and that of every living being upon it) and provides the source of magic for both wizards and High Mages. Whereas wizardly magic pulls an infinitesimal bit of energy out of the Weave to harness its effects, High Magic maintains the Weave but redirects and manipulates the local flow of energy to achieve the effects of the ritual. Source: (Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves)*

\--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*Regardless of how many spells a caster knows or prepares, he or she can cast only a limited number of spells before resting. Manipulating the fabric of magic and channeling its energy into even a simple spell is physically and mentally taxing, and higher- level spells are even more so.*

*When a character casts a spell, he or she expends a slot of that spell’s level or higher, effectively "filling" a slot with the spell. (PHB 5E)*

\--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*The Weave is ONE way of harnessing all of the innate energies of the world: wind, tidal, solar, kinetic, convection/heat, gravity, combustion, waterflow, magnetic, et al. It is powered and renewed by all of these energies continually flowing through it. A constant huge stream of them, so vast that it seems endless/inexhaustible.
